speaker: Tracey Travis

speaker: Tracey Travis

speaker: Tracey Travis

speaker: Tracey Travis
title: Executive Vice President and CFO at EstÃ©e Lauder Companies

speaker: Tracey Travis
title: Executive Vice President and CFO at EstÃ©e Lauder Companies

speaker: Tracey Travis

speaker: Tracey Travis

speaker: Tracey Travis
